items.caption: FIGURE 1 | Scalability analysis: inference latency (ms, log scale) versus number of RIS elements N for CNN-LSTM [O(N)], Coordinate Descent [O(KN^2), K = 5], and CNN-Transformer [O(N^2)]. ... CNN-LSTM is the only method that remains below 1 ms for all N ∈ {32, 64, 128, 256} (0.08, 0.16, 0.32, 0.64 ms, respectively). CD (K = 5) exceeds 1 ms above N = 32 (3.04 ms at N = 64, rising to 73.0 ms at N = 256). The CNN-Transformer already violates URLLC at N = 32 (1.1 ms) ... reaching 48.6 ms at N = 256. Latency annotation values are read from experimental measurements; RMSE and latency data are tabulated in Table 8 (Section 5.9).
